sources.quote: HD 109246, also named Funi, is a G-type main-sequence star in the constellation Draco.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.1 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,728 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
